UI_SaveSlots_KeySaveAs_tooltip: Opens the Save Slots window: save, overwrite, load, rename and delete named saves.
UI_SaveSlots_SleepSaveOption_tooltip: Each time your character falls asleep, the game is saved into the "Sleep Save" slot, replacing the one from the last sleep.
UI_SaveSlots_ErrSleepTaken: You already have a save named "%1", so Sleep Save did not overwrite it. Rename that save to use Sleep Save.
UI_SaveSlots_AutoBackupOption_tooltip: Saves a backup copy by itself after this much play time, so a crash never costs you more than that. Paused time does not count. It saves while the game is paused (Esc menu or pause), so your play is not interrupted. If you do not pause within 3 minutes, it warns you and saves once no zombies are near.
UI_SaveSlots_AutoBackupCount_tooltip: How many Auto Backup slots to rotate. Each new backup replaces the oldest one.
UI_SaveSlots_AutoBackupNotify: Show a message after each Auto Backup
UI_SaveSlots_AutoBackupNotify_tooltip: Shows "Saved: Auto Backup 1" above your character. Errors are always shown.
UI_SaveSlots_AutoBackupWarn_tooltip: When an Auto Backup has to happen while you play (no pause within 3 minutes), shows "Auto Backup in 30 s" and "in 10 s" above your character first.
UI_SaveSlots_UseFolderOption_tooltip: New saves and Auto Backups go to the folder below instead of the game's Saves folder. Older saves stay where they are and move there when overwritten. Saves there don't show in Load Game; load them from the Save Slots window.
UI_SaveSlots_FolderOption_tooltip: Use Browse... below, or type a full path, for example D:\PZ Saves. It is created if needed. Not inside OneDrive. On another drive, overwriting a save takes longer.
UI_SaveSlots_FolderDefault: Saves go to the game's Saves folder (change in Options > Mods > Save Slots)
UI_SaveSlots_FolderProblem: Can't use %1 (%2), saving in the game's Saves folder
UI_SaveSlots_FolderWhy_not_absolute: type the full path, like D:\PZ Saves
UI_SaveSlots_FolderWhy_in_saves: it is inside the Saves folder
UI_SaveSlots_FolderWhy_missing: folder not found, was a drive removed?
UI_SaveSlots_PickerButton_tooltip: Pick the save folder from a list of your drives and folders.
UI_SaveSlots_ErrAutoSlot: "%1" is saved automatically. Pick another name for your own save.
UI_SaveSlots_ErrAutoTaken: You already have a save named "%1", so Auto Backup did not overwrite it. Rename that save to use Auto Backup.
UI_SaveSlots_ListLabel: This world's saves. Click one to load, rename, delete or overwrite it:
UI_SaveSlots_LiveSave: Changes as you play (the game keeps saving into it)
UI_SaveSlots_ConfirmOverwrite:
Overwrite "%1" (saved %2)
with the game as it is now?
The old copy will be replaced.
UI_SaveSlots_ConfirmLoad:
Load "%1"?
Your main world goes back to that save.
Progress since then is lost unless you
Save As first. "%1" itself is kept as it is.
UI_SaveSlots_ErrExists: A save named "%1" already exists. Pick another name.
UI_SaveSlots_ErrForeign: "%1" is not a save of this world, so it was not touched. Pick another name.
UI_SaveSlots_ErrEmptyName: Type a name for the save.
UI_SaveSlots_ErrMultiplayer: Save Slots only works in single-player.
UI_SaveSlots_ErrNoSave: Saving is turned off for this game.
UI_SaveSlots_ErrBusy: The game is still writing the world. Try again in a moment.
UI_SaveSlots_ErrPlaying: That is the save you are playing now.
UI_SaveSlots_ErrNotFound: "%1" was not found. It may have been renamed or deleted.
UI_SaveSlots_ErrNoJava: Save Slots Java part is not loaded. Check ZombieBuddy and allow Save Slots.
